summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a share buy-back programme announced on 27 May 2026. The programme repurchased 105,275 shares at an average price of NOK 62.66 per share, for a total of approximately NOK 6.6 million (EUR 0.6 million). The buy-back was executed on the Oslo Stock Exchange to meet obligations under employee share-based incentive plans, authorized under the EU Safe Harbour Rules. After completion, Cadeler holds 169,267 treasury shares, representing less than 0.1% of its total share capital. The programme terminated early upon reaching its maximum limit. This is a small, routine capital return rather than a transformative special situation, with little risk-arb interest.
